description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing candidates within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidate records, along with internal logic for handling candidate-vacancy associations and validation rules.

classes.name: CandidateAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing candidate data, including CRUD operations and vacancy associations within the recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list candidates with optional filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new candidate record, including associated vacancy and history recording.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Populates a Candidate entity from request parameters.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Populates a CandidateVacancy entity for association with a candidate.

methods.name: setCommonCandidateHistoryAttributes
methods.description: Sets common attributes on CandidateHistory entities such as candidate ID, action, performer, and timestamp.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a candidate.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides validation rules applicable to candidate creation and updates.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove candidates by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete requests.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific candidate by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single candidate.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update candidate information.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for candidate update operations.

methods.name: performCandidateVacancyUpdateCriteria
methods.description: Implements logic to update candidate-vacancy associations based on request input.

methods.name: attachVacancy
methods.description: Creates a new CandidateVacancy association and logs the history.

methods.name: removeVacancy
methods.description: Removes an existing CandidateVacancy association and logs the removal.
